notes.title: Update: YouTube Music Now Available!
notes.content:
Hi guys! First of all, thanks for all the support and interest in Retro Ride during the Racing Fest. We're super happy to hear you're enjoying the game.

We have finally released one of our most anticipated features: the YouTube music integration! Want to listen to your own music while exploring Sunset City? From now on, you can do so simply by copy-pasting the YouTube link! Cruise the city to your favorite playlist and navigate the streets to the beats you know and love.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/khzTCsG/Screenshot-4.jpg[/img]

Make sure to join the fun in Discord and speak to the devs and the whole team behind Retro Ride!

[url=https://discord.gg/bB775me3YJ][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1283980/extras/DiscordRR.png?t=1642434099[/img][/url]

notes.title: Major Announcement: DEMO is now available!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! For all of you who've been wish listing the game and looking forward to trying it out, we have some exciting news! ːsteamhappyː We've been hard at work this week preparing for the Racing Fest and are really happy to have released a fun [b]demo [/b]for you all to try out.

For everyone who's going to be trying Retro Ride out for the first time, we really hope you enjoy it and are looking forward to your feedback.

We've always been open to your ideas and are dedicated to continuing to work on Retro Ride together with you, by listening to your feedback.

We can promise fun, hot, content which will tickle your nostalgia even further.

Make sure to join the fun in Discord and speak to the devs and the whole team behind Retro Ride!

We're super inspired to continue working on it together with you, listening to your feedback and ideas; and are already thinking of new content and visions for the game.

We can promise fun, hot, content which will tickle your nostalgia even further.

Let us know how you're enjoying the ride! We're eager to hear!
